verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an official Node.js client library for the eSignature REST API ([docusign-docs-40], [docusign-docs-13]). Its OpenAPI-Specifications repo says these specs are used with swagger-codegen to generate its client SDKs ([docusign-gh-1], [docusign-gh-3]), which points to a generated multi-language SDK family. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SDKs in languages other than Node.js, SDK reference docs or version/maintenance detail, and independent hands-on reports about the SDKs specifically (community feedback covers the REST API, not the SDKs).
